coverage.unit: arcs (file, from_line, to_line) from coverage arc table; lines derived from arc endpoints > 0. A test's reach is the union of its setup, run and teardown contexts. Run-only sizes are in per_test_size.

pytest_deadfixtures.boundary: Collection-time analysis. Fixtures requested dynamically (getfixturevalue, usefixtures strings) or consumed externally need direct review. Equal fixtures do not imply equal behavior.
pytest_deadfixtures.result: Cool, every declared fixture is being used.
pytest_deadfixtures.validation: On a scratch probe with the same pytest/plugin/python, the plugin reported the one unused fixture (never_used_fixture), so it works on this runtime.

static_crosscheck.method: Name match against any parameter name or string literal in tests/ (non-archive). Weak, since a same-named parameter anywhere counts.

scoping.rule: A file is charged in full to every area it imports (column sums exceed the suite total). exclusive_* counts files whose GSE imports fall in exactly one area. Area = first segment after GSE. (top-level modules give their module name); `from GSE import X` resolves to X when X is a module or package. Pseudo-areas: [scripts/ (non-GSE)], [no GSE import]. Time = per-test minimum across the two plugin-free runs.

experiment_stack_only_files.criterion: Every GSE import in the file, including function-local and importlib.import_module literals, is under the listed experiment-stack prefixes.

identical_body_exact.criterion: AST dump of the body without its docstring; decorators, signature and name excluded. Parametrize data lives in decorators, so equal bodies can still run different inputs.

no_assertion.criterion: No assert statement, no raises/warns/approx/deprecated_call, and no call to a name starting with assert or check, anywhere in the body (nested defs included). Helpers with other names that assert internally are not seen.

unmeasured.why: Each replaces sqlite3.connect via monkeypatch with a function that asserts '?mode=ro' or fails on any connection. pytest-cov switches coverage context at each phase and coverage flushes to its own SQLite file, which hits the patched connect while the patch is still active: attempt 1 raised INTERNALERROR and left the patch in place, so 5,959 later tests errored. These 4 were deselected for the coverage run only. Their cost and outcome come from the plugin-free runs.
No subprocess coverage was configured. Tests that launch `python`/scripts via subprocess or sys.executable have reach limited to the parent process. They are tagged in coverage.zero_reach.
--cov=GSE measures only the GSE package; tests that exercise scripts/ show only their GSE reach.

Module-level GSE code runs at import during collection and is recorded under the empty context, not under any test (16493 arc rows). Tests that only read module-level tables or call dataclass-generated methods therefore show zero reach.

Shared-scope fixtures (module/class), lru_cache and lazy singletons credit their code to the first test that triggers them, so reach sets depend on the fixed collection order. No stability rerun or reordering was done.
Both plugin-free runs shared the machine with other sessions (other GSE pytest runs and voice tools). Timings are wall-clock under recorded load, not isolated measurements.
